subject: Finexa - security evidence & buying process (post-demo)
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@finexa.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finexa.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@finexa.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Finexa - security evidence & buying process (post-demo)

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Thanks again for your time this morning. Quick recap from our demo and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned: 

1) Stakeholder map (as I heard it):
   - Technical Security reviewer: Raj Patel (Security) — will validate SOC 2 scope, pen test details
   - Legal: Lena Ortiz — contract and data processing addendum (DPA)
   - Procurement: Tom Reynolds — PO / procurement timeline
   - Economic buyer: Emily Zhao (CFO) — budgeting / final approval

2) Security evidence you asked for today (we can provide):
   - SOC 2 Type II report (2025) — executive summary and auditor attestation
   - Pen test executive summary and remediation high-level notes
   - Sample audit logs and retention policy (CSV sample / retention SLA)
   - Answers to your security questionnaire (we’ll redact where necessary)

3) Mutual action plan (proposed):
   - By Fri 2/13: Redwood to share SOC 2 exec summary, pen test exec summary, sample logs, and a pre-filled security questionnaire (attachment).
   - Week of 2/16: Security sync (30–45 min) with Raj + our security lead to review items and outstanding questions.
   - By 2/23: Procurement/Legal confirm PO timing and contract redlines.

4) Asks for you: please confirm the full list of internal stakeholders (cc’ed Lena + Tom are already included) and the procurement timeline so we can plan resources on our side. Also let us know if you prefer a security-only call or a combined Legal+Security session.

Attachments: redwood-security-questionnaire-answers.pdf (stub)

Thanks — happy to jump back on a call if useful.

Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142
From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@finexa.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finexa.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@finexa.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Finexa - security evidence & buying process (post-demo)

Alex — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers and a bit more context from our side: 

- Stakeholders: you captured the map correctly. Adding Raj (security) — his email is raj.patel@finexa.com — he will be the one signing off on SOC 2 scope and pen test details.
- Legal (Lena) will handle DPA/contract redlines.
- Procurement timeline: we are targeting vendor selection by end of February; procurement (PO) typically takes 2 weeks once terms are agreed.
- Economic buyer: Emily Zhao (CFO) — she will want a short cost/benefit summary and clarity on data residency and retention.

We attached a one-page list of our security points to close and a spreadsheet with stakeholder contacts.

Attachments: finexa-security-contacts.xlsx (stub)

I can confirm that a security-only sync with your security lead + Raj next week (week of 2/16) works better. Please share the SOC 2 exec summary and pen test exec summary before that call.

Best,
Sarah
Head of IT Operations | Finexa
sarah.li@finexa.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Finexa - security evidence & buying process (internal)

Looping you all in on Sarah’s reply. Action items I propose (internal):

- Marissa: I'll own the SOC 2 exec summary and will prepare a redacted report extract to share by EOD Fri (2/13).
- Monica: can you prepare the pen test executive summary + high-level remediation status? They asked for exec summary only (no raw findings).
- Ben: please own the procurement/commercial liaison — Tom will ask for PO timeline and a commercial contact; be ready to provide pricing summary and a 1-pager for Emily.
- Alex: prep the security-only call invite for week of 2/16 once Monica confirms availability.

Notes from Sarah (copied): "We are targeting vendor selection by end of February; procurement (PO) typically takes 2 weeks once terms are agreed." — keep that in mind for our mutual action plan.

Let me know if any of this is a stretch for timelines.

— Marissa

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 09:00:00 -0800
Subject: Finexa - security package + proposed next steps

Hi all — quick follow-up with the materials Marissa and Monica prepared. Per our plan, attached are: 

- redwood-soc2-2025-summary.pdf (redacted executive summary; includes auditor and scope)
- redwood-pen-test-2025-exec-summary.pdf (high-level findings + remediation status)
- audit-logs-sample.csv (sample logs and field descriptions)
- redwood-security-questionnaire-answers.pdf (pre-filled answers to the spreadsheet you sent)

Proposed next steps:
- Please review materials by Tues 2/17.
- Security sync between Raj and our security lead (Monica) — proposed 30 min on Wed 2/18 or Thu 2/19. Monica, please confirm your availability.
- Procurement: if terms look OK, ask Tom to share PO cadence and any standard contract terms we should pre-seed. Ben will be your commercial point.

If helpful, we can also provide a short 1-page commercial summary for Emily that ties cost to expected ROI/latency savings — Ben, could you draft that and share by Monday?

Attachments: redwood-soc2-2025-summary.pdf; redwood-pen-test-2025-exec-summary.pdf; audit-logs-sample.csv; redwood-security-questionnaire-answers.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to the security sync.
